description_en: WUYING Workspace supports two account types: convenience accounts and Enterprise AD accounts. This operation creates an office network (formerly known as a workspace) for Enterprise AD accounts
description_zh: 无影云电脑支持便捷账号和企业AD账号这两种账号体系。本接口用于创建一个基于企业AD账号的办公网络（原工作区）
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-ad-connector-office-site --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cidr-block 47.100.XX.XX --cen-owner-id 1026819517150000 --cen-id cen-3gwy16dojz1m650000 --verify-code 120000 --bandwidth 1 --domain-name example.com --domain-user-name Administrator --domain-password testPassword --office-site-name test --enable-admin-access true --desktop-access-type Internet --enable-internet-access true --sub-domain-name child.example.com --mfa-enabled false --dns-address 192.168.XX.XX --sub-domain-dns-address 192.168.XX.XX --specification 1 --ad-hostname beijing-ad01 --protocol-type ASP --backup-dns 192.168.2.100 --backup-dc-hostname dc002 --vswitch-id vsw-uf68bgq7rjwbqpg00000 --access-attribute example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateADConnectorOfficeSite

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service (EDS)
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The IPv4 CIDR block for the office site's VPC. The system uses this IPv4 CIDR block to automatically create a VPC. We recommend that you use one of the following CIDR blocks or their subnets:

- `10.0.0.0/12` (The subnet mask length must be 12 to 24 bits.)

- `172.16.0.0/12` (The subnet mask length must be 12 to 24 bits.)

- `192.168.0.0/16` (The subnet mask length must be 16 to 24 bits.)
parameters.help_zh:
办公网络VPC包含的IPv4网段。系统将根据输入的IPv4网段，自动创建一个专有网络VPC。建议您使用以下网段及其子网作为IPv4网段：

- `10.0.0.0/12`（掩码有效范围为12\~24位）
- `172.16.0.0/12`（掩码有效范围为12\~24位）
- `192.168.0.0/16`（掩码有效范围为16\~24位）
parameters.name: cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

- If you do not specify `CenId`, or the specified CEN instance belongs to your Alibaba Cloud account, you do not need to specify this parameter.

- If the specified CEN instance belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account, you must specify that account's ID
parameters.help_zh:
云企业网实例所属的阿里云账号ID。

- 如果未配置CenId，或者配置的CenId属于本阿里云账号，该参数无需配置。
- 如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，请填写所属阿里云账号的ID
parameters.name: cen_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance
parameters.help_zh: 云企业网实例ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The verification code. If the `CenId` that you specify belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account, you must first call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/436847.html operation to obtain the verification code
parameters.help_zh: 验证码。如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，必须先调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/436847.html获取验证码
parameters.name: verify_code

parameters.help_en:
The peak public bandwidth, specified in Mbit/s. The value can range from 0 to 200.
If you omit this parameter or set it to 0, internet access is disabled.
parameters.help_zh:
公网带宽峰值。取值范围：0~200。    
不设置该参数或者设置为0表示不开通互联网访问功能
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The domain name for the enterprise AD. Each domain name must be unique
parameters.help_zh: 企业AD的域名。相同的域名只能注册一次
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The domain administrator's username. The username cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

> Use the sAMAccountName, not the userPrincipalName
parameters.help_zh:
域管理员的用户名。最长支持64个英文字符。

> 用户名请使用sAMAccountName，不能使用userPrincipalName
parameters.name: domain_user_name

parameters.help_en: The domain administrator's password. The password cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 域管理员的用户密码。最长支持64个英文字符
parameters.name: domain_password

parameters.help_en:
The name of the office site. The name must be 2 to 255 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
This parameter is empty by default.
parameters.help_zh:
办公网络名称。长度为2~255个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。    
默认值：空
parameters.name: office_site_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to grant local administrator permissions to cloud desktop users. Default: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否为使用云电脑的用户赋予本地管理员权限
parameters.name: enable_admin_access

parameters.help_en:
The method for connecting to cloud desktops.

> VPC connections are established using Alibaba Cloud PrivateLink, which is a free service. If you set this parameter to `VPC` or `Any`, PrivateLink is automatically enabled
parameters.help_zh:
连接云电脑时允许使用的接入方式。

> VPC连接方式依赖于阿里云私网连接PrivateLink服务，该服务不收取费用。该参数设置为`VPC`或者`Any`时，系统将自动为您开通私网连接服务
parameters.name: desktop_access_type

parameters.help_en: This parameter is deprecated. Use the `Bandwidth` parameter to manage internet access
parameters.help_zh: 是否开通公网访问功能
parameters.name: enable_internet_access

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the enterprise AD child domain
parameters.help_zh: 企业AD子域的域名
parameters.name: sub_domain_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable multi-factor authentication (MFA)
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启多因素认证MFA
parameters.name: mfa_enabled

parameters.help_en: An array that contains the IP address of the DNS server for the enterprise AD. You can specify only one IP address
parameters.help_zh: 企业AD对应DNS的IP地址。目前仅支持设置一个
parameters.name: dns_address

parameters.help_en: The DNS address of the enterprise AD child domain. If you specify `SubDomainName` but not this parameter, the DNS address of the child domain is considered the same as that of the parent domain
parameters.help_zh: 企业AD子域的DNS地址。如果设置了`SubDomainName`，而未设置此参数，则认为子域DNS和父域一致
parameters.name: sub_domain_dns_address

parameters.help_en: The AD Connector type
parameters.help_zh: AD Connector规格
parameters.name: specification

parameters.help_en:
The domain controller hostname.
The hostname must comply with Windows hostname naming conventions
parameters.help_zh:
域控主机名。
必须符合Windows主机命名规范
parameters.name: ad_hostname

parameters.help_en: The protocol type
parameters.help_zh: 协议类型
parameters.name: protocol_type

parameters.help_en: The DNS address of the backup domain controller
parameters.help_zh: 备用域控DNS地址
parameters.name: backup_dns

parameters.help_en: The hostname of the backup domain controller
parameters.help_zh: 备用域控主机名
parameters.name: backup_dc_hostname

parameters.help_en: The list of vSwitch IDs
parameters.help_zh: 交换机ID列表
parameters.name: vswitch_id
